newsitem.title: IRAN: Industrial waste kills 500,000 fish in Iran river.
newsitem.headline: Industrial waste kills 500,000 fish in Iran river.

text.p: Industrial waste has killed 500,000 fish in a river in southern Iran, a newspaper said on Thursday.

The daily Kayhan said a suit was filed against the unnamed industrial plant in the southern city of Shiraz after an official environmental report accused it of dumping poisonous waste in the Kor river.
In 1994, one million fish were killed in the same river allegedly by waste dumped by a sugar mill.
